name: vault-inspector
description: Scan an Obsidian vault for long-term maintenance problems.

scripts.lint:obsidian-warnings: eslint "src/**/*.ts" --ignore-pattern "src/tests/**" --rule 'import/no-nodejs-modules:error' --rule 'obsidianmd/prefer-window-timers:error' --rule 'no-restricted-globals:["error",{"name":"fetch","message":"Use the built-in `requestUrl` function instead of `fetch` for network requests in Obsidian."}]'
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Roger Deng
